reGoggles

Open Smart Goggles For Industrial AI Assistance

Currently in development. Product design and features are subject to change before final release.

Sees What the Workers See, Enables What They Couldn't

By capturing, recording, and streaming the first-person perspective of field technicians, reGoggles delivers the data to cloud or on-device AI for analysis. This enables early warning, real-time documentation, and post-event optimization.

First-Person Inspection

Automated visual inspection doesn't fit manual assembly lines, and manual inspection varies from person to person, often missing critical defects. By bringing AI-assisted quality inspection directly to the line, reGoggles catches defects in real time, helping reduce rework and improve yield.

  • HD Camera Detects Subtle Defects

  • In-Line AI Inspection

  • Step-Level Defect Traceability

Data-Based Improvement

Production planning relies on line-team experience, and making improvements often takes weeks without data-backed evidence. With end-to-end first-person recordings, reGoggles lets AI quantify operations and recommend concrete improvements.

  • Data-Driven Frontline Analysis

  • Rapid After-Action Reviews

  • Timeline-Based Anomaly Pinpointing

On-Site PPE Monitoring

PPE and hazard detection are critical in chemical and construction industries. Manual safety checks cannot cover the full shift, leaving recurring gaps. Unlike regular safety goggles, reGoggles provides continuous PPE and hazard monitoring throughout the shift.

  • Monitoring While Working

  • Early Danger Alerts

  • First-Person Incident Replay for Accountability

Hands-Free Copilot

Calling in an on-site expert is slow and costly, and workers can't easily consult a phone or manual when both hands are occupied. By streaming the worker's first-person view, reGoggles delivers real-time hands-free support from remote experts or AI.

  • Operations Auto-Logged into SOPs

  • Hands-Free AI Guidance

  • Remote Experts Collaboration

Evidence Recording

Compliance audits in petrochemical and other regulated industries demand airtight process evidence, yet on-site records rarely stand up to scrutiny. With reGoggles, first-person footage records the process in the field while AI verifies compliance in real time.

  • Auto-Linked to Workstation, Operator, and Shift

  • Open Data Pipelines with Local-First Security

  • Real-Time Recording with AI Verification

Ego Data Capture

First-person operation data from real industrial settings is invaluable for training embodied AI. Conventional ego-capture devices lack rugged protection and hard-hat compatibility, so they can't be deployed at many industrial sites. Built for frontline use, reGoggles makes ego data capture possible.

  • Hard-Hat Compatibility

  • Passive Ego Data Capture

  • Modular Design for Expandable Sensors

Designed For Industrial AI

With safety, data capture, and hands-free use at its core, reGoggles fits seamlessly into the industrial intelligence systems of enterprises and developers alike.

Goggle-Form Capture and Protection

Designed to replace standard safety goggles — protection and capture in one device.

Modular Sensor Expansion

Two expansion ports for additional cameras, ToF depth sensors, IMUs, or other custom modules.

Hands-Free Audio Interaction

3 mics and 2 speakers for voice commands and audio feedback — hands-free, eyes on the job.

Open-Source Firmware and SDK

Built on the open Allwinner V881 platform — free to develop your own custom apps without lock-in.

Synchronized Multimodal Capture

Video, audio, and IMU data streams on one synced timeline.

Universal Data Connectivity

Standard Wi-Fi and BLE interfaces transmit data to your edge AI, cloud AI, and other applications.

Your Data. Your AI. Your Rules.
